topicLedger.title: Local-full coverage is still partial
topicLedger.decision: Do not claim local-full or SOTA completion until all planned shards are accepted and combined.

topicLedger.title: BM25 remains the lexical floor
topicLedger.decision: Keep BM25 in every fair comparison and use it as the fallback/control arm.
topicLedger.nextAction: Compare every promoted retrieval method against BM25 on the same accepted shard set.

topicLedger.title: Local Apple rerank is the current local winner
topicLedger.evidence: local-apple-qwen3-0_6b-local-rerank score 28.405; delta vs BM25 4.275; delta vs base 6.425.
topicLedger.decision: Treat local rerank as the current method-refinement candidate, not as a public benchmark claim.
topicLedger.nextAction: Keep local rerank in shard-009 and watch whether the gain survives beyond 40% coverage.

topicLedger.title: Plain full-hybrid is not promoted on current answer-quality evidence
topicLedger.decision: Do not treat deterministic full-hybrid as superior after shard-004 aggregation.
topicLedger.nextAction: Use per-shard diagnostics to identify whether dense or rerank ordering is hurting specific categories.

topicLedger.title: Query expansion remains negative
topicLedger.decision: Keep query expansion experimental and disabled as a default method until a same-data accepted shard win appears.
topicLedger.nextAction: Audit rewrite quality, fallback frequency, and category sensitivity before spending more full-shard cycles.

topicLedger.title: Wiki title and subtopic amplification are wired but unproven
topicLedger.evidence: wiki fixture query count 3; winner bm25-lite; quality delta vs BM25 0.
topicLedger.decision: Do not promote title or subtopic boost from a fixture tie.
topicLedger.nextAction: Run a local-wiki shard plan or retrieval-proxy stress slice that includes wiki-title and wiki-subtopic arms.

topicLedger.title: Hosted Supermemory comparison is separate from local-full methodology
topicLedger.evidence: hosted canary quality 0; RecallWeave canary quality 0.1212; query count 8.
topicLedger.decision: Do not compare local-full partial shards to Supermemory reported SOTA or free-tier canaries as if they are the same benchmark.
topicLedger.nextAction: Use hosted Supermemory only in explicit hosted-baseline runs; keep it disabled for method refinement shards.

storagePolicy.rule: Use public wiki pages for method recall and private local indexes for raw evidence review.

nextActions: Run shard-009 with hosted Supermemory search disabled and regenerate this ledger.
Run a local-wiki shard plan before promoting title or subtopic amplification beyond fixture status.
Keep raw LongMemEval material outside repo-facing wiki artifacts; index it only in local private storage.
